exposure: Patients discharged from ICU, Patients who died in ICU
cohort: 19 pregnant and puerperal women with COVID-19 admitted to the ICU
finding: Critically ill pregnant/parturient patients with COVID-19 experienced a high mortality rate, particularly those requiring mechanical ventilation and longer ICU stays.
mod_finding: The rate of Cesarean section was high (89.4%) among the studied cohort.
gest_age: Mean birth week was significantly lower in patients who died in ICU.
